name: Cigna Healthcare Dental (individual & family dental plans)
notes: Researched from public cigna.com pages only (no sign-in; dental.cigna.com renders by JavaScript and showed no text). The individual dental plans page lists the plan line-up with 'from' prices (national averages for one person) and points members to myCigna, but it has no billing text. Cigna's individual & family plans page lists three ways to pay a premium: online ('Pay your premium online'), by check to the address on the bill, or by phone at 1 (877) 900-1237 (TTY 711, M-F 8am-8pm ET); renewing and existing customers log in to myCigna to pay, and the first premium must be paid before a plan is activated. That page is written for individual & family plans generally, so the payment capabilities are recorded as 'inferred' for dental. AutoPay, cancellation, paperless, fees, grace period, sign-in identifier and MFA are not published for dental plans and keep family defaults. Plan prices are 'from' national averages that vary by area, so no plan list is modelled. Signed-in nav labels other than myCigna are generic (synthetic). Review 2026-10-09: the dental plans page's sign-in link reads Log in to myCigna, now the sign-in label. Re-checked: the payment page still lists online, check and phone for individual & family plans and notes Cigna Dental plans continue for 2027, so payment evidence stays inferred for dental. Public nav added.

help.title: Ways to pay your premium
paragraphs: Cigna's individual and family plan pages list three ways to pay: online, by check, or by phone.

Online: if you are renewing or already a customer, log in to myCigna to pay. By check: use the mailing address printed on your bill and follow the instructions there. By phone: call 1 (877) 900-1237 (TTY 711), Monday to Friday 8am to 8pm Eastern.
steps: Enter the amount and payment method.

help.title: Your first premium payment
paragraphs: A new plan is not active until the first premium payment has been made, so pay it right after you enroll.

help.title: Cigna individual dental plans
paragraphs: Low deductible plans (Cigna Dental Preventive, Cigna Dental 1000 and Cigna Dental 1500) start from about $19 a month. The high annual maximum plan, Cigna Dental 3000/100, starts from about $44 a month.
Bundled plans (Cigna Dental Vision 1000, Cigna Dental Vision Hearing 2000 and 3500) start from about $32 a month, and the Cigna Dental Advance 2000 and 3000 plans from about $54.66 a month.
These are national averages for one person; your premium depends on where you live. For a quote call 1 (855) 352-1604, Monday to Friday 8am to 8pm Eastern.

help.title: What you can do in myCigna
paragraphs: Activate your myCigna account to review your coverage, find plan documents, get ID cards, look up providers, and view and pay claims. Help is available around the clock, and there is also a mobile app.

extra.intent: Using the Cigna help pages, find the phone number to call to pay an individual plan premium by phone. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using the Cigna help pages, find what has to happen before a newly purchased individual plan becomes active. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: The first premium payment must be made before the plan is activated.
